persona.h2: Whoever you are, someone remembers you
persona.sub: A grandparent at home, a daughter far away, a grandchild who wants to be closer — senior companionship and family care, with a place kept for every one of them.
persona.1.q: Alone at home — her sore knee, her grandchild's wedding, her favourite old street. She wants someone to remember what she said, and to keep her company.
persona.1.p: Munea chats with her every day and keeps it all in mind. When it’s time for her meds or a check-up, her phone reminds her — nothing to memorise, nobody to trouble.
persona.2.q: Busy, far away, shy about calling all the time. She just wants to know Mom and Dad are okay today.
persona.2.p: She opens the app and sees what her parents chose to share today — their mood, whether the meds were taken. The worry from afar finally has somewhere to rest.
persona.3.q: He wants to be closer to grandma and grandpa — he just never knows what to talk about.
persona.3.p: A family walking challenge, a quick quiz game — the laughter does the talking, and three generations get a little closer.

features.h2: An AI health companion that becomes part of the family
features.sub: Keeping health numbers and reminders in one place, chatting as naturally as face to face, and bringing the whole family together — the three things Munea does every day.
feat.1.badge: Your health numbers in one place
feat.1.alt: Munea app health data and reminders screen
feat.1.h3: Meds, check-ups and the numbers — all kept in mind
feat.1.p: Set medication and appointment times and the phone reminds you right on time. Connect Apple Health and steps, heart rate, blood pressure, blood oxygen and sleep come in automatically.
feat.1.li1: Meds & check-up reminders — right on time, no scolding if one slips
feat.1.li2: Health trends at a glance — steps, heart rate, blood pressure, sleep
feat.1.li3: Apple Health sync — with your permission, no manual logging
feat.1.li4: Rings even when the app is closed — reminders are scheduled on the phone
feat.2.badge: As natural as talking face to face
feat.2.h3: A chat so natural, it feels face to face
feat.2.p: Munea chats with your loved ones — just by talking, no typing. A moving face, a natural voice, and she remembers where you left off — like having someone sit beside them for a talk.
feat.2.li1: Interrupt anytime — she stops and listens first
feat.2.li2: A moving face — her mouth moves as she speaks, so it feels like someone’s there
feat.2.li3: Remembers what you said — picks up right where you left off
feat.2.li4: Tells you when she isn’t sure — built not to play doctor; like any AI, she can get things wrong
feat.3.h3: See how everyone's doing — and have fun together
feat.3.p: In the family care circle, everyone can see and look after the health and mood updates each person chooses to share — and start little games like a walking challenge or a quiz to add some fun to time together.
feat.3.li1: Health & mood — family sees only what each person chooses to share
feat.3.li2: Walking challenges — the whole family competes on steps
feat.3.li3: Quiz games — a little friendly fun, with more laughter
feat.3.li4: A little extra care when things seem different — she checks in more gently; family sees what’s shared

tech.h2: FamilyWellness AI — your family's health & care companion
tech.tag: The real-time intelligence that makes company feel truly present.
tech.intro: She isn’t an assistant that answers anything. Memory, awareness, conversation and safety work together as one caring intelligence — that’s what’s underneath, and why she isn’t like other AI.
tech.archCap: How she remembers you — and stays within safe limits
arch.memory.p: Each chat is distilled into key points — core, long-term, recent and today — so names, family, a sore knee or a favorite walk are still there next time.
arch.perception.p: Each morning she prepares today’s weather, air quality, appointments and important dates, so the conversation starts in the right place.
arch.interaction.p: Real-time voice you can interrupt anytime, a face whose mouth moves with her voice, a distinct personality and voice for each character — and a safety check that stops inappropriate replies.
arch.orch.h4: One reply, all of it considered
arch.orch.p: The moment you finish speaking, what she remembers, today’s context, her personality and the safety rules come together into one reply. Safety always comes first.
cmp.cap: How she's different from a general AI
cmp.1.a: A general assistant that answers anything
cmp.1.b: Memory, awareness, conversation, safety and personality working together
cmp.2.a: Usually text or a generic voice, no face
cmp.2.b: An expressive face and natural voice, answering in real time
cmp.3.b: A personality with character — switch her, switch the voice and rapport
cmp.4.b: Proactively builds today's context every morning
cmp.5.b: Doesn’t diagnose; medication is only a reminder; tells you when she isn’t sure
cmp.6.b: Not a long-term care system — an everyday health companion for the whole family
tech.close: FamilyWellness AI — real technology built to do one simple thing: remember you, understand the moment, and respond to you well.
faq.sub: Worried about your parents but can't be there every day? Here's what people want to know before they download.
faq.1.q: My parents live alone and I'm far away. What's a good way to look after them?
faq.1.a: Have your parents install Munea, install it yourself, and join the same family health circle. Whenever they feel like talking, an AI companion chats with them by voice, remembers what they've shared, and reminds them about medicine and check-ups on time. When you open the app, you can see the health and mood updates they choose to share. What you can see is always up to them.
faq.2.q: Is there an app that reminds older parents to take their medicine?
faq.2.a: Munea does. Set the medication times in the app and a notification arrives right on time, even when the app is closed. You can set check-up and appointment reminders too, and a missed dose never brings a scolding. Munea only reminds; it never evaluates or changes medication. Always follow your doctor's and pharmacist's instructions.
faq.3.q: What is Munea, and who is it for?
faq.3.a: Munea is an AI health companion app for iPhone, made for the whole family. Older parents chat with an AI companion by voice and get medication and check-up reminders. Adult children far away join the family health circle to see the health and mood updates their parents choose to share. It is not a long-term care system or a medical device. It's a companion for everyday family health.
faq.4.a: Munea is free to download, and new accounts get 5 trial credits (1 credit is about 1 minute of conversation). There are two paid plans: Plus includes 100 credits a month and a family health circle of up to 4 people; Pro includes 200 credits a month and up to 12 people. On the US App Store, Plus is US$19.99 a month and Pro is US$39.99 a month (yearly: US$199.99 and US$399.99); other regions show local prices. The price shown in the app is what you pay. You can buy extra credits anytime, and subscriptions renew through the App Store and can be canceled at any time.
faq.5.a: No. Nina and Milo are Munea's AI companions: illustrated characters with AI-generated voices. They tell you plainly that they are AI, never pretend to be human, and never impersonate a member of your family.
faq.6.q: Are my conversations recorded? How is my privacy protected?
faq.6.a: Your voice is encrypted and processed in the cloud, outside Taiwan, only to understand what you say. Munea doesn’t keep raw audio recordings; only key points of the conversation are saved so she can remember you next time, and you can view or delete them anytime under My data in the app. Your data is never sold or used for advertising. Family members only see the status and summaries you authorize, and full transcripts are not shown by default.
faq.7.a: The person who created the family health circle (the circle owner) taps Invite family on the Family tab to get a 6-digit invite code (valid for 72 hours) and sends it to a relative. The relative downloads Munea, signs in, taps Join the family health circle on the Family tab, and enters the code. Right now, creating an invite and joining a circle each require a Plus or Pro plan; a Plus circle holds up to 4 people and a Pro circle up to 12, including the owner.
faq.8.a: No. Munea does not diagnose, prescribe, or give treatment advice, and it is not an emergency service. What it does is keep your loved ones company, remind them about medicine and check-ups, and help you see the health updates your loved ones choose to share. For any health concern, please see a doctor or pharmacist.
faq.9.q: My parents aren’t comfortable with smartphones. Can they still use Munea?
faq.9.a: Yes. Munea is voice-only, so there is nothing to type, and medication and appointment reminders appear on their own at the set time without opening the app. The first time, it helps to sit with them to download the app, sign in and set the reminder times. After that, they just open the app when they want to talk.
faq.10.q: If my parent falls or feels unwell, will Munea alert the family?
faq.10.a: Please don’t rely on Munea to alert anyone in an emergency. It has no fall detection and is not an emergency service, and it does not notify family when your parent hasn’t opened the app. If someone feels unwell or there is an emergency, contact local emergency services or a medical provider directly.
faq.11.q: Is there an Android version? Where can I download Munea?
faq.11.a: No. Munea is iPhone-only for now (iOS 15 or later). It is on the App Store in the United States, Canada, Taiwan and Japan, and both the app and voice conversations work in English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese and Spanish.
final.p: Free to download, with 5 trial credits (about 5 minutes of talk). iPhone only — on the App Store in the US, Canada, Taiwan and Japan.
org.title: For care providers | Munea partnerships
org.description: Bring Munea to your care home or day center: residents talk with an AI companion that remembers them, get medication reminders, and families see updates.
org.ogTitle: Munea for care providers: voice companionship families can see
org.ogDescription: Residents just talk, get medication and appointment reminders on time, families see updates, and your organization gets a monthly operations report. Start small, scale once it works.
org.eyebrow: For long-term care homes, day centers and senior living
org.h1:
Every resident in your care,
remembered every day
org.sub: Munea can be provided to care organizations in bulk: residents talk with an AI companion just by speaking, families see updates on their own phones, and your organization receives a monthly report on use and care. It is software only and runs on facility tablets or residents' own phones.
org.imgAlt: Munea app family health circle screen
org.usesH2: Covering the moments staff cannot reach
org.usesSub: Care staff go off shift; caring does not have to. Here is what residents, families and your organization each get.
org.c1.p: Residents just talk, with no typing. Long-term memory lets each conversation pick up where the last one left off, and at night or in quiet hours there is an AI companion to talk to.
org.c2.p: Residents get phone reminders right on time, with no scolding if one is missed. Munea only reminds — it never assesses or adjusts medication — and it does not replace your facility’s medication rounds or handovers.
org.c3.p: Families connect on their own phones and see the updates, mood and reminder status a resident chooses to share. What they can see is up to the resident.
org.c4.p: Organization plans with 10 or more seats include a monthly usage and wellbeing report: counts and categories only, no conversation content, and only for residents who agree. Details are set out on the partnership site and in the contract.
org.how1: Pick 10–20 residents for a 2–4 week pilot, and review together how smoothly it runs, what families say and when staff need to step in; pilot terms are as agreed by both sides.
org.how2: Billed by active seats: from NT$499 per seat per month in Taiwan, each with a fixed monthly allowance of call credits (Plus 100, Pro 200; 1 credit is about 1 minute), with top-ups available. Organization seats are priced separately from personal subscriptions.
org.how3: Decide to expand, adjust or stop against goals agreed up front; final pricing and responsibilities are set in the contract.
org.finalH2: Partnership options, reference pricing and the pilot process
org.finalP: Everything is on the Munea partnership site, where you can also book a 30-minute consultation. Family-care plans for employers are on the same site.
org.note: Munea is a supportive care and reminder tool. It does not replace human care, medical diagnosis or emergency services. Formal quotes are governed by the contract agreed between both parties.
foot.desc: Munea — the AI health companion that remembers. A face that moves and a voice that remembers, keeping you and your family close. Not a long-term care system: everyday companionship and family care.
foot.disclaimer: Munea is a companion for company and daily reminders. It is not a medical device and does not provide diagnosis, treatment, or emergency medical services. For health concerns, consult a doctor. In an emergency, contact your local emergency services.
start.h2: Not great with phones? Three steps.
start.sub: Your parent doesn’t need to open the app every day: medication and appointment reminders ring on their own, and they talk whenever they like. Set it up together once.
start.1.h3: Download it and try a chat
start.1.p: Sign in with Apple or Google and get 5 free credits — about 5 minutes — to hear how she talks.
start.2.h3: Set it up on your parent’s iPhone
start.2.p: Help them sign in and set medication and appointment times together — ideally next time you’re with them, phone in hand.
start.3.p: They open the app and talk — no typing. Reminders ring on their own, so there’s nothing to remember.
start.note: Want to see each other’s updates on your phones? Create a family health circle and join it with an invite code; each person decides what they share. Right now, every member of a family circle needs a Plus or Pro plan.
